purpose: Find whether fixed-length HMC can meet the user's NUTS continuous-parameter diagnostics at lower cost.
selection: Use the actual training and sampling seed 49, not the directory's repetition label 1.
controlled_settings: Only the continuous trajectory kernel/length differs. Same data, lambda_sum=1e-3, lambda_L1=1e-6, prior, 4 random-start chains, warmup=2000, retained=5000, target_accept=.8, no thinning.
nuts_reference_reason: One same-server NUTS reference avoids claiming a wall-clock speedup from runs on different hardware. Shared-server timing is descriptive, not a dedicated benchmark.
diagnostic_policy: Keep all fits; beta and continuous eta/theta require Rhat<=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400. Report gamma constants, unavailable diagnostics, finite gamma Rhat/bulk failures, PIP MCSE and divergences separately. Do not call unavailable gamma diagnostics a pass.
validation_policy: Select using diagnostics and cost, not C-index/MSE. A passing seed49 fit requires additional seeds before recommending a general protocol.
scope: Only these four fits. No Exponential or RHS. Existing grid stays stopped; no automatic bulk resume.
